title: sigtool: move to an updated nix-community fork
description:
Move sigtool source to nix-community/sigtool
Add support for options required by swift-build
Add support for nested bundle signing (used by lots of real software)
Import a patch which was carried in nixpkgs.

This is a part of the work to get swift-build's swbuild working in nixpkgs (https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/512622) and use it to build real applications like hammerspoon without hacks or rewriting most of the build system.

This change should be purely additive with existing behaviours unchanged. Only the arguments required by swbuild have been added and the nested signing needed for existing apps. (swbuild calls codesign with specific hardcoded arguments) It has been tested, successfully building hammerspoon, alt-tab-macos and passing the standard macos bootstrap build without issues. I also tested a random sample of projects which depend on sigtool as much as time allowed.

Since sigtool has been largely unmaintained for a long time, the original author agreed to move the project to nix-community and gave me the commit rights. I'm happy to be a maintainer for now (but if anyone is more interested, please step in!)

The alternative proposed path of giving rcodesign a compatible interface was raised with upstream, but didn't receive any response. It was easier to add the missing pieces to the existing sigtool project.
